name.description: Readable name, such as smoked salmons.

ranges.description: Per nutrient (kcal, fat, protein, carbs, salt): the 5th percentile, the median and the 95th percentile.

front_image.description: Front of the pack, JPEG or PNG, at most 250 KB.

label_image.description: Cropped nutrition-table photo, JPEG or PNG, at most 400 KB.

revision_id.description: Chosen by the client; resending the same id is safe.

issues.description: The plausibility checks the numbers failed. Empty when none.

status.description: accepted: every account sees it. pending: only you, because a check failed.

missing.description: Macros that at least one entry did not report.

reverted.description: Enough accounts disputed it, so the product went back to its previous facts.

eaten_on.description: Local calendar date the client assigned.
Local calendar date the client assigned.

attribution.description: Credits for the data sources the foods come from.

health_records.description: Weight, waist, appetite, nausea and dose records. Absent in older backups.

fact.description: Absent when no community fact exists.

kcal.description: Required. kcal per 100 g or 100 ml.

category.description: How this food's category looks per 100 g, so the client can tell when the values are far outside it.

community.description: The nutrition comes from a community correction shared by every account.

image_path.description: Same-origin path of the product image.

stale.description: Cached from Open Food Facts and not checked for 90 days.

medication.description: Required for a dose, empty otherwise.

recorded_on.description: Local calendar date the client assigned.

value.description: kg, cm, a 0 to 5 rating, or mg, by kind.

recovery_codes_saved.description: False until the person confirms they saved the codes shown at signup or after making new ones.

base_seq.description: Optional. Only used to report a conflict; it never blocks a write.

data.description: The entity body. Required for upsert, absent for delete.

op_id.description: UUIDv7 created with the mutation. Replaying it is safe.

conflict.description: An existing row was newer than base_seq and was overwritten.

tombstone.description: The deleted row, when status is tombstoned.

data.description: The full row for an upsert; {deleted_at} for a delete.

next.description: Pass this as since on the next pull. It equals the last seq in the page, or since when the page is empty.

cursor.description: The user's head sequence after the batch.

days.description: Every date in the range, including days with no entries.

servings.description: Portions the recipe makes. Absent in older backups, which means 1.

id.description: Null for catalog hits: look the barcode up to log it.

fiber_g.description: Fibre target in grams. 0 or absent means not tracked.

med_supply_doses.description: Doses on hand as of med_supply_as_of.

server_date.description: The server's current UTC date. The client never uses it to assign eaten_on.

counter.description: The number that makes SHA-256(salt + ':' + counter) start with challenge.bits zero bits.

recovery_codes.description: Shown once. Each resets the password one time.

kcal.description: Rounded to a whole number after summing unrounded entries.
